hero_tagline: Copy and paste star kaomoji — Japanese text faces with starry eyes, sparkles, and star-struck excitement. Click any face to copy it instantly.
intro: Star kaomoji (also spelled star kamoji) are Japanese-style text faces built around ★ and ☆ — for excitement, wonder, and starry-eyed hype. A star kaomoji like (★ω★) or ☆*:.｡.o(≧▽≦)o.｡.:*☆ is plain Unicode text, so it pastes cleanly into bios, captions, comments, and usernames. Browse starry eyes, excited stars, sparkle stars, and wishing stars below and click any face to copy it instantly.
